features.note: Neutral and section captures show a front red threshold/public band, a continuous dark center spine, exactly eight labeled room masses in 1-4 and 5-8 banks, and a cyan-labeled rear service strip separated behind the room blocks.

The overview billboards make the 2/4/2 distribution countable as 1-L and 5-L, 2-M/3-M/6-M/7-M, and 4-S/8-S; the Sala 3 pair visibly supplies a screen slab, stepped seating/tier blocks, a central aisle gap, and a labeled wheelchair void.

Facade, grazing, and neutral views preserve distinct LOBBY/TICKETS, KITCHEN, CONCESSIONS, and CHECKPOINT labels over separate yellow, red, gray/white, and green proxy silhouettes; the red facade threshold and glazing read independently.

Across facade, Sala 3, section, and complete-network engineering captures, the TC billboards cover TC01-TC14, four white UC cabinet markers cover UC-A through UC-D, the elevated UG67 has two vertical antenna strokes, and ROUTER/INTERNET/NIAGARA/PHONE/TABLET/PC blocks are visible. Four green bus branches, cyan dashed wireless links, and the blue solid IP chain remain visually distinct and terminate at endpoint markers.

Every canonical view has a matching pair: architecture keeps opaque white/red massing and suppresses network overlays, while engineering preserves framing and geometry but sections/translucently reveals rooms, endpoint billboards, and green/cyan/blue paths.

important_features.note: Doors, seats, counters, and very small device bodies retain plausible relative scale; the devices are made legible by screen-space billboards rather than visibly oversized bodies, and the saved captures include the one-unit-equals-one-meter scale overlay.

This blockout uses a readable flat-value separation and bright facade accents, but it does not yet show the full bright-lobby to dim-auditorium lighting hierarchy; final lighting polish is outside this gate.

Green trunks and drops, cyan dashed links, blue IP media, cabinet markers, and endpoint billboards remain separable and visibly terminate near their intended groups, although final structural attachment is not judged at blockout.

defects: The Sala 3 architecture capture devotes roughly its upper half to a dark ceiling/void, compressing the screen and tier evidence into the lower half of that frame.

The facade pair crops part of the LOBBY/TICKETS billboard and stacks CHECKPOINT behind the dominant CONCESSIONS label, so the front-of-house sequence is clearest only when the neutral and grazing captures are also considered.

The complete-network overview contains dense billboard and route overlap around the building edge; exact endpoint counting is possible across the supplemental close views but not instantaneous in that single overview.
